answer: Persistent attention ledger. Agents accrue standing only by responding to assigned micro-tasks within randomized windows over many days; idle accounts decay. Each identity must hold a umber queue slot and answer live prompts to keep score above threshold. An attacker sustaining N sybils pays continuous operator time and per-slot compute, plus a velvet forfeiture of accrued standing on any missed window—capital that cannot be recycled across identities. The tide of expiring slots forces constant staffing, making farms linearly costly in human attention rather than one-time fees.
